messages:
ellie: Hey team — quick life update! We closed on a house today AND we're expecting our first baby in August 🎉🍼 We're planning a small housewarming/baby shower weekend in mid‑July — would love ideas. Moving boxes start end of June, so might be slightly MIA. <3
sam: OMG congrats!!! that's amazing!!! so happy for you :tada: :heart: 
jordan: wow double celebration!! house pics when you unpack pls 🏡
maya: Yesss. mid‑July works for me. in‑person > virtual if possible.
taylor: Congrats! Do you have a registry or a wishlist? want to coordinate gifts.
ellie: thanks all! Link: https://example.com/registry/ellie-jones (feel free to ignore heavy stuff, plants & books always welcome)
riley: I can bring snacks + pizza. also volunteer to help move boxes on June 28?
ben: count me in for moving duty. what time?
kira: can we do a quick poll? July 10 or July 17? in‑person or hybrid?
sam: July 17 pls
maya: July 10 🙋
taylor: hybrid if majority remote
giphy-bot: *posts gif* https://giphy.com/gifs/celebrate-cheer-3o6ZsYz4wY2Gx
ellie: poll link: https://polls.example.com/ellie-shower (please vote!)
ben: also thinking group card? Venmo for contributions: venmo.me/redwood-team
riley: love this. congrats again @ellie!!!
sam: :tada: :heart_eyes: 
ellie: you all are the best. can't wait to celebrate. will update after poll. :)
